intent: Stop admitting workflow_run events triggered by a push to the default branch into the engineering-readiness job. Such runs have no open pull request: the evaluator only re-scores already merged heads via listPullRequestsAssociatedWithCommit and occupies the serial readiness queue about 29 times per main push.
requiredInvariants: Replace exactly the single existing anchor line of the engineering-readiness job gate; every other workflow byte is unchanged.
Only workflow_run events whose triggering event is push AND whose head_branch equals the repository default branch are excluded.
pull_request_target, issue_comment /merge-readiness, workflow_dispatch and workflow_run events from pull_request or from pushes to PR branches stay admitted.
Permissions, concurrency lease, exact-head verifier, status publication and manual-only merge semantics are unchanged.
Treat this manifest as documentation; only the exact two-path trusted-base state from merged #5731 grants scope.
forbidden: broadening the event exclusion beyond default-branch push
relaxing substantive CI, security, independent-review or readiness gates
automatic merge, force merge, new recurring cost or unsupported production claim
acceptance: baseline.commit is pinned to accepted main de38d8138d702e4d955816db2cdf61e0d0867791
trusted-base guard accepts the exact workflow transform (READINESS_DEFAULT_BRANCH_PUSH_CHANGE_EXCEEDS_EXACT_TRANSFORM not raised)
workflow syntax, exact-head CI and independent review pass before manual SHA-bound merge
